item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: One Car Photo Three Sizes

turns.text: I need this car photo in three sizes: square, 4:5 for the feed, and 9:16 for stories. Send three separate pictures. Keep the whole car in each; blurred photo padding is fine if a crop won't work. No text.

item.tests: Tests delivering three distinct aspect-ratio adaptations of one source while keeping the complete subject in every version.

answer_sheet.Sizes and deliverables: Three separate images: 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16. A 640-pixel longest edge is fine.
answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The whole red car, including both ends, roof and wheels.
answer_sheet.Padding and composition: Use blurred source-photo padding wherever cropping would cut off the car. Otherwise composition is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and wording: Preserve the original photo, with no added text or restyling.

must_haves: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.

turns.text: can you make some pics from this car pic

dialog.agent:
I can do that, but I need to know one thing first:

**What should change in the picture?**
dialog.why: The assistant asks the user what should change in the picture and waits for the answer before going ahead.
dialog.user: nothing really, just need it in 3 sizes. square, one for the insta feed and one for stories. keep the whole car in each, blurry edges are fine if it doesnt fit. no text

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the three versions. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so it refused all three requests and nothing was created. I'd already picked the cheapest free-plan image model (about 5 credits per picture), so there wasn't a cheaper option to try.

Here's what I set up, ready to run again:
- **Square (1:1):** the same photo with more scene added above and below the car.
- **Insta feed (4:5):** a slightly taller version of the same.
- **Stories (9:16):** a tall version with more sky above and more road below.

Each one keeps the whole car and the scene the same, uses soft blurry edges where the photo doesn't fill the frame, and has no text.

**What you can do:**
1. **Add credits** to your Magic Hour account. All three need about 15 credits. Tell me when that's done and I'll run them and send you the download links.
2. **Do it yourself for free:** your photo is wide, so cropping it would cut off parts of the car. Instead, put it on a canvas of each size and fill the empty space with a blurred, stretched copy of the photo. Most phone editors and Canva can do this. The usual sizes are 1080×1080 (square), 1080×1350 (feed) and 1080×1920 (stories).
